I thought maybe it was just a delay, but some of these have been nearly a day without the reward being delivered.

After about eight of these offers not working properly, I have decided to write a review. I can understand one or two being a fluke, but this many is clearly intentional false advertisement.

reviews.title: Very fun but beware of the ads
reviews.text:
This is a great game, but there is one glaring issue: the advertisements. Now I know that developers have to make money, so advertising is necessary. I think giving bonuses for viewing advertisements is a great idea, and one which this game does reasonably well.

My issue with this is the inclusion of game-crashing advertisements. You can't predict which one will come up, but sometimes you can get unlucky and blow an 8 hour+ bonus on a crappy, game crashing advertisement. It's hard not to feel cheated once you watch an entire ad and see it not only crash your game, but also fail to credit you with having wasted your time watching it.

Other than that, the game is great. If you don't intend to watch the ads to get bonuses, then this is a definite five star game.

I would play for days at a time, slowly building my virtual empire, until one day, I decided to take a shot at following its instructions, and I started small, with lemonade. Then I grew to newspaper, car washing, pizza delivery, donut shops, etc. I kept growing and growing until I had grown enough wealth to erase my identity so that nobody would know who I was, and I could like in solitude with my money. Thank you to the wonderful people who created this game and changed my life forever.

reviews.title: Time to boycott
reviews.text:
This is an amazing game. Fantastic in fact! I have beaten all the planets, and still come back to do the events from time to time. But now it must be deleted and boycotted. There are advertisements in app now. This app used to be a paragon of a mobile game, never showing ads unless we clicked on something to receive a bonus. And oh boy did I click on ads. I watched dozens of ads a day on this app; getting bonuses to multipliers, free speed boosts, extra angels, and small gifts. It was amazing. But now advertisements pop up in the middle of game play. 
Despicable. 
In an ever hostile and parasitic environment, this app showed us what could be, a game without compromise. And now it has succumbed to the filthy and underhanded practice of shoving ads in any orifice it can find. Oh how the mighty have fallen. 
So long and thanks for all the lemons.
